profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with almost three years of experience on embedded systems and two year of experience on Automotive.
My interest are on Embedded Systems, IoT and Data Science related topics.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded Engineering in Automotive. Activities such as requirements analysis, detail design, code implementation, static and dynamic testing in an agile methodology environment.

positions.title: ADAS Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Development on Power Supply and Real Time Operative Systems for RADAR/LIDAR products following AUTOSAR standards.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Software code revisions and testing for many vehicle models under Contiental's quality standards.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer Intern
positions.description: Design and development of embedded systems as well of diverse low and mid level drivers for product applications aimed for energy and cost reduction without the use of third-party heavy libraries

educations.fieldOfStudy: Ingeniería eléctrica, electrónica y de comunicaciones

projects.title: FreeRTOS Embedded OS Implementation on a 8bit Microcontroller
projects.description: Development of FreeRTOS scheduler, proccess comunication, semaphores and mutex for the PIC18F2550 microcontroller

projects.title: IQ Math Library
projects.description: Develpment of math operations addition, substraction, multiplication and division as well the trigonometric sin function on IQ format with variable Q on inputs and the output.
